name: Intern-Decision (0.8B, 2B, 4B)

lineage.how_derived: fine-tuned with a masked-next-token decision objective; probabilities read from the logits of single-token option symbols at placeholder positions, then calibrated

purpose: Multimodal structured decisions: a shared state, a schema of named questions and optional images in, an answer distribution per question out in one forward pass (card; technical report arXiv 2610.22131).

benchmarks.name: vendor suite average (JevBench Easy/Original/Hard, Typed Decision, ToolACE, AG News, WildJailBreak)

strengths: A decision model reads a state (text, JSON, images) and a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for every option in one forward pass; it does not generate text.
4B beats the hosted Jev average on the vendor's suite at 44 ms on a 4090
weaknesses: suite chosen by the vendor, includes its own typed-decision set
best_for: cheap routing, moderation and tool-selection classification
soft.maturity: InternLM lab release with a technical report; 4B 5.9k downloads, 96 likes

tona_fit.reason: The smallest credible decision models (0.8B to 4B, Apache by tag) from an established lab; useful as a router or guardrail next to a worker. Not a worker.
blockers: decision readout needs its own code path

open_questions: rank on the independent Decision Index board
